title: The Works Seattle

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Hands-on, instructor-led events for Seattle teams who want to make something together. Events start at $75 per person and are available in our West Seattle studio or at your location. We host groups of 10-20 in our studio, with no cap for on-site events. We recommend booking at least 6 weeks out to secure your preferred date and time, although we're always happy to work with shorter timelines when we can. Workshops engage teams in creative learning. Folks leave with a handcrafted work product, a new skill or appreciation, and deeper connections with their colleagues. Hosted on-site at your location or in our Fremont studio. We pride ourselves on our dynamic and engaging virtual instruction.
